title: Page 128
transc:
Hd Qrs Gen'l Butler May 14th 1864.
Maj Eckert Di  4 P. M.
from flag ship Malvern near Bermuda hundreds may
fugitive Imogene for Buxton zebra the panama Pelton
of Kidnap of the attica opal has just
arrived at Turkey Island left bank zodiac they
left with glory promise men last heavily on
the way and came from mechanics ville yesterday
zebra their timely appearance will relieve us from
sharp shooters & facilitate our operations now in
progress for clearing out torpedoes walrus neptune finis
R OBrien


War Dept Washn 8.45 P. M. May 14 / 64
R OBrien Hd Qrs Gen'l Butler .
for Knave Jupiter desires that you will
have the garden and Bracket Weldon cut
if possible youth Jacob Nelly Slow time
Thos T Eckert


Gen'l Butlers Hd Qrs. May 15th 1864
8.45 A.M.
Maj Eckert Di
from make in the field may ghost agnes
for Indian zodiac wrangle of fever in relation
to bracket welch rec'd zebra General Kautz was
sent out for that purpose Thursday May flood
also with directions to cut Bergen Canal if
possible please wrangle Jupiter walrus Knox all well
R OBrien
